source_section: Local vs Global Deviance in Scalp EEG
evidence_paraphrase: Human scalp EEG shows local mismatch (MMN) is sensory/temporally localized, whereas global deviance (P3b) elicits widespread fronto-parietal activity; ubiquitous local oddball activity across all levels is not observed.
manual_notes: Bekinschtein et al. explicitly show that local oddball responses are restricted to sensory auditory cortex and are not ubiquitous across the brain hierarchy. verification_note: Directly tests local vs global dissociation; local mismatch is anatomically restricted rather than ubiquitous.

manual_notes: The model implements PV interneurons as delivering additive/subtractive somatic inhibition to balance feedforward drive, rather than performing divisive multiplicative gain reduction. verification_note: Computational proof that PV interneurons mediate divisive gain control under specific network regimes.
